ck_attendance_leave_code.name: ck_attendance_leave_code
ck_attendance_leave_code.value: leave_code is null or leave_code in ('AL', 'UAL', 'SL', 'USL', 'PL', 'ML', 'CL', 'EL', 'LWP', 'TOIL', 'VTO')

ck_audit_module.name: ck_audit_module
ck_audit_module.value: module_code is null or module_code in ('jobs', 'planning', 'performance', 'settings', 'audit-log')

ck_task_completion_progress.name: ck_task_completion_progress
ck_task_completion_progress.value: declared_progress is null or declared_progress between 0 and 100

ck_task_progress_range.name: ck_task_progress_range
ck_task_progress_range.value: previous_percentage between 0 and 100 and new_percentage between 0 and 100

ck_task_transitions_from.name: ck_task_transitions_from
ck_task_transitions_from.value: from_state is null or from_state in ('REQ', 'ACT', 'PEN', 'APP', 'REJ', 'CAN', 'OVERDUE')
